description: Crypto prices in USD and other currencies. Three modes: (1) coins as CoinGecko IDs or tickers (up to 50) for live price, 24h change and market cap in the requested currencies; (2) tokens as chain:address (e.g. base:0x833589fC…, ethereum:0x6982…) for any DEX-traded token; (3) at (past ISO date or unix seconds) for historical USD prices of coins and tokens. Params: coins, tokens, currencies (default ['usd']), at. Price: $0.002 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"coins":["bitcoin","ethereum"],"currencies":["usd"]}.

at.description: Past ISO date or unix seconds for historical USD prices

coins.description: List of coin IDs or ticker symbols. Accepts CoinGecko IDs (e.g. 'bitcoin', 'ethereum') or common tickers (e.g. 'BTC', 'ETH', 'SOL'). Max 25 coins per call.

currencies.description: Target fiat currencies. Default: ['usd']. Supported: usd, eur, gbp, jpy, chf, aud, cad, btc, eth.

name: crypto_prices
title: Crypto Price Lookup
